XV13114, XV13115, XV13116 auto logic (ref. F13FD401_FP1 misc tab) and initiate a Sequence Stop (F13-

before F13-SEQ-0016A is able to remove the MB_RUN command, the PCS will set MB_MILL_EN = 0 to force the

IF HS13748MODE = Automatic THEN:
• MB_2S_BRK is activated as per F13-SEQ-0016C OR manually by the CRO if MB_RUNNING = NOT RUNNING (include button on DCS)

See 14. Cause & Effects tab for initiating conditions

When MB_2S_BRK is ACTIVE:
1. Set SV13812, SV13813, SV13808 AND F13-PO-532 to AUTO
2. De-energise SV13812, SV13813 and SV13808

ONLY 1 CAN BE ACTIVE AT ANY TIME: MB_2S_BRK, MB_EN_BRK, MB_RL_BRK. 
The active tag is to latch, and unlatch when another tag becomes active.

Parking Brake for Ball Mill

IF HS13748MODE = Local AND HS13749BRK = Engage, THEN activate MB_EN_BRK

See 14. Cause & Effects tab for initiating conditions

IF MB_EN_BRK = ACTIVE then:
Immediately energise SV13812, and de-energise SV13813 and SV13808 AND
Set F13-PO-532 to AUTO.

ONLY 1 CAN BE ACTIVE AT ANY TIME: MB_2S_BRK, MB_EN_BRK, MB_RL_BRK. 
The active tag is to latch, and unlatch when another tag becomes active.

Common Release Brake for Ball Mill

IF HS13748MODE = Automatic THEN MB_RL_BRK is activated as per F13-SEQ-0015A OR manually by the CRO (include button on DCS) OR
IF HS13748MODE = Local AND HS13749BRK = Release, THEN activate MB_RL_BRK OR
IF HS13748MODE Rising Edge Trigger (Local to Auto), THEN activate MB_RL_BRK

Interlocks # 8 to 17 initiate an 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop'
An 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop' interlock will activate MS_NCR_ILK to trip F13-CV-403 and
initiate a Sequence Stop (F13-SEQ-0022A) to stop F13-MS-401A/B. Refer to Misc tab.
The condition Delay On timers here are longer than MS_NCR_ILK, such that if the conditions here become
true before F13-SEQ-0022A is able to remove the MS_RUN command, the PCS will set MS_MILL_EN = 0
to force the SAG Mill to coast to stop (i.e. an instantaneous stop).
These conditions can only become active if MS_OP_MODE = NORMAL (NORMAL MODE)

Interlocks # 8 to 17 initiate an 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop'
An 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop' interlock will activate MS_NCR_ILK to trip F13-CV-403 and
initiate a Sequence Stop (F13-SEQ-0022A) to stop F13-MS-401A/B. Refer to Misc tab.
The condition Delay On timers here are longer than MS_NCR_ILK, such that if the conditions here become
true before F13-SEQ-0022A is able to remove the MS_RUN command, the PCS will set MS_MILL_EN = 0
to force the SAG Mill to coast to stop (i.e. an instantaneous stop).
These conditions can only become active if MS_OP_MODE = NORMAL (NORMAL MODE)

Interlocks # 8 to 17 initiate an 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop'
An 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop' interlock will activate MS_NCR_ILK to trip F13-CV-403 and
initiate a Sequence Stop (F13-SEQ-0022A) to stop F13-MS-401A/B. Refer to Misc tab.
The condition Delay On timers here are longer than MS_NCR_ILK, such that if the conditions here become
true before F13-SEQ-0022A is able to remove the MS_RUN command, the PCS will set MS_MILL_EN = 0
to force the SAG Mill to coast to stop (i.e. an instantaneous stop).
These conditions can only become active if MS_OP_MODE = NORMAL (NORMAL MODE)

Interlocks # 8 to 16 initiate an 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop'
An 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop' interlock will activate MB_NCR_ILK to bypass the Ball Mill via
XV13114, XV13115, XV13116 auto logic (ref. F13FD401_FP1 misc tab) and initiate a Sequence Stop (F13-
SEQ-0016A) to stop F13-MB-401A/B. Refer to Misc tab. If the Ball Mill is tripped, the SAG Mill will operate in Single
Stage SAG. It is recommended the circuit is sequence stopped if the Ball Mill fails restart.
The condition Delay On timers here are longer than MB_NCR_ILK, such that if the conditions here become true
before F13-SEQ-0016A is able to remove the MB_RUN command, the PCS will set MB_MILL_EN = 0 to force the
Ball Mill to coast to stop (i.e. an instantaneous stop).
These conditions can only become active if MB_OP_MODE = NORMAL (NORMAL MODE)

Interlocks # 8 to 16 initiate an 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop'
An 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop' interlock will activate MB_NCR_ILK to bypass the Ball Mill via
XV13114, XV13115, XV13116 auto logic (ref. F13FD401_FP1 misc tab) and initiate a Sequence Stop (F13-
SEQ-0016A) to stop F13-MB-401A/B. Refer to Misc tab. If the Ball Mill is tripped, the SAG Mill will operate in Single
Stage SAG. It is recommended the circuit is sequence stopped if the Ball Mill fails restart.
The condition Delay On timers here are longer than MB_NCR_ILK, such that if the conditions here become true
before F13-SEQ-0016A is able to remove the MB_RUN command, the PCS will set MB_MILL_EN = 0 to force the
Ball Mill to coast to stop (i.e. an instantaneous stop).

Interlocks # 8 to 16 initiate an 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop'
An 'Abnormal Shutdown, Mill Delayed Stop' interlock will activate MB_NCR_ILK to bypass the Ball Mill via
XV13114, XV13115, XV13116 auto logic (ref. F13FD401_FP1 misc tab) and initiate a Sequence Stop (F13-
SEQ-0016A) to stop F13-MB-401A/B. Refer to Misc tab. If the Ball Mill is tripped, the SAG Mill will operate in Single
Stage SAG. It is recommended the circuit is sequence stopped if the Ball Mill fails restart.
The condition Delay On timers here are longer than MB_NCR_ILK, such that if the conditions here become true
before F13-SEQ-0016A is able to remove the MB_RUN command, the PCS will set MB_MILL_EN = 0 to force the
Ball Mill to coast to stop (i.e. an instantaneous stop).
These conditions can only become active if MB_OP_MODE = NORMAL (NORMAL MODE)

For Cyclone Feed Valves in MANUAL Mode:
• A_Lo and A_Hi indicate when Cyclone Feed Valves need to be opened / closed manually by CRO (see PID Cont tab)

Selected Cyclones will be in DUTY mode. 
If a Cyclone Feed Valve is changed to DUTY, set it to AUTO mode (one shot). DUTY Cyclone Feed Valves that are in AUTO are called to open or close as described above, in accordance with the priority system described below. DUTY Cyclone Feed Valves that are in MANUAL are manually opened or closed by the CRO. 
Deselected Cyclones will be in STANDBY mode.
STANDBY Cyclone Feed Valves are forced to Close Trip (as per OnOff Valves tab).

Cyclone Feed Valve Priority System:
Incorporate a CRO entered priority system, ranging from '1' (highest priority) to '15' (lowest priority), for auto open and close operation of DUTY selected Cyclone Feed Valves that are in AUTO. This hierarchy will dictate the sequence in which Cyclone Feed Valves automatically open or close as per F13CALC10007 Calculations tab (if HS13092 = Pressure Control) or F13CALC10011 Calculations tab (if HS13092 = Level Control).
• The top 6 highest priority DUTY Cyclone Feed Valves are opened in AUTO mode (see OnOff Valves tab). 
• The remaining DUTY Cyclone Feed Valves auto open in ascending order of priority as Cyclone feed pressure increases. 
• Cyclone Feed Valves will auto close in descending order of prior↓ity as Cyclone feed pressure decreases.
• STANDBY selected or Cyclone Feed Valves in MANUAL mode will not auto open and close and are to be disregarded from the priority system. 
• STANDBY feed valves are close tripped (see OnOff Valves tab).
• If a Cyclone Feed Valve fails to open / close, the next priority DUTY and AUTO Cyclone Feed Valve will open / close. The failed Cyclone Feed Valve will be forced into STANDBY MODE.

If a Gravity Cyclone 1 OR 2 Feed Valve is opened, the next available lowest priority opened Cyclone Feed Valve will close simultaneously.
If a Gravity Cyclone 1 OR 2 Feed Valve is closed, the next available highest priority closed Cyclone Feed Valve will open simultaeneously.

NOTE: It's up to the CRO to ensure that the priorities assigned to the DUTY selected Cyclone Feed Valves achieve an even distribution of operating Cyclones across the entire Cyclone cluster and that the priorities are assigned to align with the cyclone maintenance strategy.
